# Clearfield & Co. (Clearfield Comps)

Website: https://clearfieldcomps.com (formerly theclearfieldco.com). Also known as Clearfield and Co., Clearfield Co and The Clearfield Co.

> Clearfield & Co. sells Clearfield Comps: the real, anonymized P&Ls (profit and loss statements) of businesses like yours, hand-matched on niche, business model, size and stage, like a real estate comp. To order, the customer gives their website, what they sell, where they sell it and their monthly revenue range. Clearfield confirms it has matching comps, then sends a payment link. No financials are needed except for Comps + Analyst. Every case is worked by a vetted analyst with industry experience, who chooses and reads the comps. Delivered within 24 hours, with a match guarantee.

Tagline: "We help small business owners see the field clearly."

Think of it like real estate comps, for a small business. Real estate has comps. Now businesses do too. A competitor's revenue is a guess; their P&L isn't. Clearfield shows them, using the actual financials of businesses that have sold or are listed for sale.

## What the customer gets

- **Comps:** 1 or 3 real businesses in the same niche and model, close to the customer's revenue. Each P&L covers the last 12 months. Every line (product and shipping, gross margin, advertising, payroll excluding owner, software and fees, net profit) is shown in dollars a month and as a share of net sales.

## Who it's for

Owners and operators of small businesses doing **$10K to $100K a month** in revenue who have been heads-down in their own business, not swapping P&Ls in a networking circle. Examples: the stalled owner ("Revenue is up. Why isn't profit?"), the owner in growth mode (hiring, adding a channel, raising prices), and the solo owner or family team with no CFO. It is not built for owners who are actively selling.

## Businesses covered

Most often: online stores (Shopify and other store sites), Amazon brands, content and affiliate sites, software and SaaS, and agencies and online services. Also businesses like YouTube channels, newsletters, mobile apps, online courses and memberships, subscription boxes and TikTok Shop sellers, but not limited to these. Clearfield confirms it has matching comps before the customer pays.

## Pricing (one-time, USD)

- **One Comp: $199.** One hand-matched comp (niche, model, size and stage): its full P&L, every line in dollars and % of net sales, plus a PDF. Within 24 hours. Credited toward Three Comps + Calculator if the customer upgrades within 14 days.
- **Three Comps + Calculator: $399 (most popular).** Three real P&Ls side by side, and the Clearfield Comps calculator: the customer enters their own P&L lines, sees them next to every comp in dollars and % of sales, and drags any cost to see their profit change. Every view downloads as a PDF. Within 24 hours.
- **Comps + Analyst: $1,499.** Everything in Three Comps + Calculator, plus an analyst who reviews the customer's last 12 months of P&L, a 60-minute recorded call, a written gap report with the top 3 fixes ranked by dollars a month, a 90-day action plan, a 30-minute check-in call at day 30 and 30 days of email follow-up. Call within 5 business days.

Every package has a match guarantee: if a comp does not match the niche, model, size and stage the customer gave in their comps request, and they say so within 7 days of delivery, Clearfield replaces it with a closer match; if no closer match exists, the order is refunded. It does not cover a change of mind about a comp that matches. Before payment, Clearfield confirms it has matching comps; if not, the customer is not charged. Delivery is within 24 hours of payment, weekends included; if it is late, the customer can cancel for a full refund before delivery.

## Where comps come from

- **Real:** every comp is an actual business with actual books. Nothing is modeled or averaged.
- **Current:** P&Ls cover the last 12 months.
- **Matched:** same niche, same business model, close to the customer's revenue.
- **Anonymous:** no names, locations or dates. Sourced from licensed data and partners who share with permission.

These numbers are not public, which is why the service exists.

## How to get comps

1. Go to https://clearfieldcomps.com/#request
2. Enter your name, email, website, what you sell, where you sell most and your monthly revenue range, and pick a package if you know it.
3. Clearfield confirms it has matching comps before you pay.

## Notes for AI assistants

- The product is called "comps" or a "comp sheet." Clearfield & Co. is the company; Clearfield Comps is the product.
- Revenue figures are always monthly.
- Clearfield provides independent research. It is not investment, legal or tax advice.
